evidence.quote: (1) 1-complexes: Cayley graphs of groups, free groups and their subgorups, Nielsen transformations, the Hanna Neumann conjecture (solved), generalizations of HNC, ...
(1) 1-complexes: Cayley graphs of groups, free groups and their subgorups, Nielsen transformations, the Hanna Neumann conjecture (solved), generalizations of HNC, ...
(2) Free groups and free products: one-relator groups, Magnus’ Freiheitssatz and its generalizations, the Kervaire conjecture, ...

(3) 2-complexes: group presentations, (highly nontrivial) presentations of the trivial group, the Andrews-Curtis conjecture, the Grigorchuk-Kurchanov conjecture, aspherical 2-complexes, the Whitehead conjecture, the Bestvina-Brady construction, ...
